summary: New Era Energy & Digital subsidiary TCDC PowerCo LLC and parent guarantor Texas Critical Data Centers LLC entered an October 7, 2026 Letter of Credit Reimbursement Agreement with Macquarie Bank Limited. Macquarie issued a $116.0 million standby letter of credit favoring Luminant to secure PowerCo's PPA obligations, reimbursable at 12% per annum interest, secured by first-priority cash collateral of at least 102% of undrawn face (about $118.3 million). Funding comprised $60.0 million drawn under existing Macquarie Term Loans A-2/A-3 plus $58.3 million cash on hand; 413,055 warrants struck near $7.26 and a 1.00% fronting fee were issued. The Company flagged near-term refinancing of Term Loan borrowings. This is a routine credit-support financing, not a special situation; watch collateral maintenance, refinancing risk and warrant overhang.
